lines.text: The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush will come over in chains and bow down to Israel.
The makers of idols will depart together in disgrace, but the LORD will save Israel with an everlasting salvation.
The LORD created the heavens, formed the earth, and did not create it to be empty but to be inhabited.
The LORD calls fugitives from the nations to draw near, and says those who carry idols of stone are ignorant.
The LORD invites the borders of Judah to turn to Him and be saved, and He swears every knee will bow.

wrong_details.true: all the ends of the earth
